notes:
Set an alliance per account and OPTiC keeps it there. On every launch the bot checks which alliance it is in, and only leaves and re-applies if it is in the wrong one - nothing happens when it is already right. Set it per account or on a whole selection with Bulk Edit; leave it blank and the account's alliance is never touched.
Number your cities 1 to 10 automatically. Turn on Rename cities and each city is renamed to its own position, left to right. It only touches a city whose name is already wrong.
Choose what appears in the sidebar - Settings, Appearance, Sidebar, or the pencil at the bottom of the sidebar. Any row can be turned off, and any tool can be given its own row. Your sidebar is unchanged until you change it.
Report cleaning no longer trips over itself on a multi-city account - it ran in every city at once and all but the first two failed. It now runs from your main city only.
RELAUNCH YOUR BOTS after updating. These are done by the reporting script, and a running bot keeps the old one.
